result.summary: The page is generally polished, but several elements appear clipped or obscured, and some inactive navigation elements have low contrast.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the lower restaurant card, abruptly hiding its image and any content beneath it.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the navigation bar and safe-area height so the final cards can scroll fully above it.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and the third card in the “Fastest near you” row are cut off at the viewport edge, including the restaurant name and delivery text.
issues.suggestion: Refine the horizontal carousel spacing and clipping behavior. Preserve consistent edge padding or use a clearer partial-card treatment to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: Inactive bottom-navigation icons and labels use very light gray on white, making them less legible.
issues.suggestion: Darken the inactive state colors to provide stronger contrast while keeping the active item visually distinct.
